components.css: @keyframes ds-sheet-in { from { transform: translateY(24px); opacity: 0.4; } to { transform: none; opacity: 1; } } @keyframes ds-pop { from { transform: scale(0.82); } to { transform: none; } } .ds-sheet { font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; max-width: 384px; padding: 8px 20px 20px; background: #fff; border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0; box-shadow: 0 -8px 32px rgba(15,23,42,0.18); text-align: center; animation: ds-sheet-in 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-handle { width: 40px; height: 4px; margin: 0 auto 16px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #d1d5db; } .ds-disc { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 64px; height: 64px; margin: 0 auto; border-radius: 9999px; background: #16a34a; color: #fff; animation: ds-pop 320ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) 60ms backwards; } .ds-word { margin: 12px 0 0; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: #166534; } .ds-sheet h3 { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; color: #111827; } .ds-table { margin-top: 20px; padding: 16px 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #f9fafb; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #e5e7eb; } .ds-table span { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #4b5563; } .ds-table strong { display: block; font-size: 60px; line-height: 1.25; font-weight: 600; color: #00428E; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ok-btn { margin-top: 20px; width: 100%; height: 48px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: #00428E; color: #fff; font: 600 16px/1 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-ok-btn span { font-weight: 400; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.75); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ok-btn:hover { background: #003578; } .ds-ok-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00428E; outline-offset: 2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sheet, .ds-disc { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
A clean mobile check-in app, played straight. The system is the familiar category standard (the kind of screen Planning Center Check-Ins or Luma's event check-in would ship) built for a volunteer holding a low-end Android phone at the church door with a queue waiting. White surfaces sit on a cool gray ground, Victory blue is the only brand color, and status is always a colored word, never color alone. Nothing is themed; the polish comes from careful spacing, generous touch targets, tabular numerals and calm, quick motion.

**Scope, plainly.** This system was introduced on the check-in screen (`/admin`), where it renders only while the `new_ui_checkin` feature flag is on, and it is meant to extend app-wide over time (registration, the VGL Portal, reports), each behind its own flag. Today nothing else follows it: the rest of the app, and `/admin` itself with the flag off, still use the older indigo-accented look of bordered cards and numbered step badges. That older look is not this system and should not be copied into new surfaces. The shared app header (`SiteHeader`) sits above every page but is outside this system and is not described here.

Density is moderate: one column, max 672px wide, 16px between blocks, list rows of about 64px. The first screen is the job: which session, how many are in, the Scan button, the search field, results.
keyCharacteristics: White surfaces on a cool gray-50 ground; Victory blue for primary actions, the selected session and focus.
Status as color plus word: On-time green, Late amber, Absent red, Waiting to sync slate.
One list surface with thin dividers, not a card per row.
Bottom sheets on phones, centered dialogs from 640px up.
Geist throughout, tabular numerals on every count, time and table number.
Drawn line icons on one 24px grid, 2px stroke; no emoji.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Victory blue is the only brand color. No indigo, no second accent. Green, amber, red and slate belong to status and are never decoration.

rules.name: The Word-With-Color Rule
rules.body: Every status shows its word ("On-time", "Late", "Absent", "Waiting to sync") next to its color. A colored dot or disc alone never carries meaning.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Counts, times, table numbers and row indexes use tabular numerals so they don't jitter as they change.

rules.name: The No Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Labels sit in sentence case at normal tracking. Uppercase letter-spaced kickers are not part of this system.

rules.name: The Thumb Rule
rules.body: On phones every tappable control is at least 44px tall; primary actions are 48px; the Scan button is 56px and full width.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Resting content is separated by rings and tone. Shadows larger than a hairline belong only to layers that float over the page.

dos: **Do** keep Victory blue the only brand color, on primary actions, the selected session and focus.
**Do** show every check-in status as its word plus its color: On-time green, Late amber, Absent red, Waiting to sync slate.
**Do** put list rows in one white 16px-rounded surface with thin dividers.
**Do** make phone controls at least 44px tall, primary actions 48px, and the Scan button 56px full width.
**Do** use tabular numerals for counts, times and table numbers.
**Do** use bottom sheets on phones and centered dialogs from 640px, rising with the 240ms exponential ease-out.
**Do** put new redesigned surfaces behind their own feature flag, next to the old UI.
donts: **Don't** reuse the older indigo-accented look (numbered step badges, indigo stat boxes, a bordered card per step) in surfaces built on this system.
**Don't** wrap each list row in its own card.
**Don't** open a modal on top of a modal; one sheet at a time.
**Don't** use emoji or glyph characters as icons.
**Don't** use uppercase letter-spaced eyebrows or kickers above titles.
**Don't** use green, amber, red or slate for decoration; they mean status.
